description: This Python source file defines a configuration class for interacting with AWS SageMaker chat endpoints. It includes methods for URL construction, request signing, and streaming responses, tailored to SageMaker's API for chat models. The class supports both synchronous and asynchronous streaming handlers and extends from OpenAIGPTConfig and BaseAWSLLM, indicating integration with a larger language model framework.
